description: Use this when someone asks about a Singapore property agent (salesperson) by name or CEA registration number, such as R028241G, including an agent asking what Homejourney shows about them. Returns matching agents on CEA's register with their agency, CEA number, Homejourney listing count and public profile URL. For a CEA number, or a name only one agent matches, it also returns the profile: transactions CEA records for them, their top areas and their public Homejourney listings, whose ids get_listing_details reads. Never returns contact details; send the user to the profile URL. Needs no sign-in.

query.description: The agent's name, or their CEA registration number.

name: search_agents

profile.description: The full profile; present when the query is a CEA number or one agent matches.

areas.description: HDB towns and private districts with the most recorded transactions.

latestTransactionMonth.description: The month of the agent's latest recorded transaction, such as 2026-07.

listings.description: Up to 10 of their public Homejourney listings.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

recordedTransactions.description: Transactions CEA records for the agent.

title: Look up a property agent
